titre: Devoir de synthèse n°1 - Anglais (7ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
This is my friend Omar. He is thirteen years old. Omar is a very good student and he likes school. His favourite subjects are Maths and English. In the morning, he gets up at seven o'clock, has breakfast and goes to school by bus. After school, he does his homework and then he plays basketball with his friends in the park. Omar has a big family. He lives with his parents, his two sisters and his grandmother. At the weekend, they often visit their uncle who lives on a farm. Omar is a happy and kind boy.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) How old is Omar and what does he think about school?   (1,5 marks)
2) What are his favourite subjects?   (1,5 marks)
3) What does Omar do after school?   (1,5 marks)
4) Who does Omar live with?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb in the present simple: Omar (get) ______ up at seven o'clock.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with "he / his": ______ favourite subject is Maths.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "good" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Make a question: "Omar likes school." (Does…?)   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
Write about your best friend (about 10 lines): his/her name, age, physical description, favourite subjects and what he/she does after school. Use the present simple.
